title: US-EAST-1 Database Cluster Degradation
rootCause: Primary database replica fell behind due to high write load, causing read queries to time out on the lagging replica.
resolution: Promoted a healthy replica and redistributed read traffic. Implemented read replica lag monitoring.
customerImpact: Intermittent 500 errors and slow responses for customers in us-east-1 affecting order processing.

title: EU Authentication Certificate Rotation Failure
rootCause: Automated certificate rotation script failed to update the SAML signing certificate in the EU-WEST-1 regional auth cluster. The old certificate was retired on schedule, leaving the region unable to validate SAML assertions.
resolution: Manually deployed updated certificate to EU cluster. Fixed automation script to verify propagation before retiring old certificate.
customerImpact: EU-based users unable to authenticate via SAML SSO for approximately 6.5 hours.

title: Rate Limiter Double-Counting Bug - Free Tier
rootCause: A race condition in the burst request counting logic causes rapid consecutive requests within the same 100ms window to be counted 2-4x their actual count.
resolution: Patch in development. Workaround: affected customers can temporarily increase their rate limit window to 10 minutes.
customerImpact: Free tier customers hitting rate limits significantly earlier than expected based on actual usage.
